review_text: I got this game when it came out on console years ago and had so much fun with my friends. When I a computer and repurchased it I continued to play it with my friends up until this fall when I took a break. At that point the game was a little janky but it was almost perfectly fine. Never would I expect that the developers wanted to regress their game back to alpha by feeding it bugs and premade models that look like ♥♥♥♥. This game has been in early access for 6 years and it's only gotten worse with every update. They new character models are just edgy guys which really tight jeans and eyebrow piercings. They should just bring back the normal looking people instead of Joe Shmo emo mgee On the topic of new, all of the tools are smaller and look stupid. Half the time when I pull out my flashlight it stays on my toolbelt and I have a floating hand of light. The tier 1 thermo is impossible to read because of size so you might as well ignore temp and interacting with anything plays this dumb ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ animation that looks like your fingering something?! Why? I never thought I would get angry a game becoming worse but this isn't a AAA studio. Why aren't they taking player criticism? More ghost interactions happen and the new ghost behavers are chatgpt brainstorms thrown under burning elephant ♥♥♥♥. They next update should be called Undo2.0 or sell GameToOtherStudio2.0. I was playing the other day and saw an events thing pop up. Wtf is that this isn't Fortnite. The new events allow you to get limited time clothes that look like ♥♥♥♥ and require playing a separate challenge mode. I wouldn't recommend buying this game until the devs get off crystal start releasing updates that benefit the game. Just wait until it gets out of early release.

review_text: I've had some great times with this game but it seems that there are more bugs than ever in this game. I've most notably had consistent issues with incense or smudge sticks just not working at all. The new "immersive animations" make this game feel a lot clunkier, slower, and overall just less responsive to input than ever before. I missed when this game was just a simple and fun game to come to when you just wanted to have fun, but the decisions in what to implement into this game have led this game off a cliff.
adjudication_notes: Bugs are framed as resulting from recent implementation choices, not standalone performance issues.

review_text: This amount of jank could be acceptable when the game first came out and the dev team was much more inexperienced, but after being on Steam for nearly 6 years, it's unacceptable. The devs seem more interested in adding more things or refreshing already good maps instead of fixing game breaking bugs. When the developers tell you "just keep playing the game till you're use to the jank," after releasing the most broken update to date, that's all you need to know about how much they care about their own product outside of it's sales figures. Even my friends don't want to play this game with me when I suggest it anymore, it's gotten that bad.
adjudication_notes: Core complaint is unfixed game-breaking bugs; the update is the trigger, not the central subject.
